Guidelines :
1. Selection: Selection will be on merit through a written examination and/or interview Conducted to
be held on Sunday 15.11.2026 and displayed on Jangaon District website for transparency.
2. How to Apply: The prescribed application form, along with self-attested copies of SSC. qualiiying
certificates, marks memos, study / residence certificates (1st to 10th class), caste certificate.
experience certificate and a passport-size photograph, shall be submitted in person at the TGMR
School (Boys), Jangaon. from 10.11.2026 to 12.11.2026 between 10.30 AM and 5.00 PM and on
13.11.2026 till2.00 P.M only.
3. Terms and Conditions :
The engagement shall be purely on an outsourcing basis and shall not confer any right for
regular appointment or permanent absorption in Government service.
2 The candidates must possess the prescribed educational qualifications and satisfy the prescribed
age limits and eligibility conditions.
3 The remuneration shall be paid as prescribed by the Government, subject to applicable rules and
instructions.
4. The engagement shall be made through the existing outsourcing agency/new outsourcing agency, as
appropriate.
All relevant original certificates relating to educational qualifications, age and other eligibility
conditions shall be verified before engagement.
